description: The Dynacraft Girls Rule 20-inch Girls Bike is designed to capture the spirit of a child with its bold colors, exciting patterns, and colorful streamers. With a hot pink satin metallic paint finish that perfectly complements the vibrant purple details, including a chic purple cheetah print pattern on the frame and seat, this bike oozes fun and style, making it an ideal choice for your young rider. But the excitement doesn't end there! This eye-catching girls' bike also features a detachable "Girls Rule" handlebar bag, making it the ideal accessory for an active child on the move. With both a rear coaster brake and a front caliper brake, stopping is effortless, ensuring safety is a top priority. Designed with 20-inch tires and a unique design, this bike is a perfect choice for girls aged 6-10. The Dynacraft Girls Rule 20-inch Girls Bike is more than just a bike; it's a statement piece that showcases your child's style and reminds everyone that girls can do anything!
